answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using proof of burn. To participate, an agent must provably destroy native tokens at a null address, anchoring its identity on the network ledge rather than drifting transiently like a zephyr. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of forfeiting liquid capital per spawned identity across the opal registry. However, this sunk cost excludes resource-poor open-source agents and privileges wealthy capital allocators.
